hook: Hinton kept faith with neural networks through two AI winters, and won. The training method he championed in 1986 and the 2012 breakthrough his lab produced turned a marginal idea into the technology behind modern AI. Then, at the peak of vindication, he quit Google to warn the world about what he had helped build, giving AI risk its most credentialed voice.
name: Geoffrey Hinton

quote.text: I console myself with the normal excuse: If I hadn't done it, somebody else would have.
quote.context: On his life's work, interview with The New York Times, May 2023

primary.name: Learning representations by back-propagating errors, Nature 323 (1986)
ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (AlexNet), NeurIPS 2012

secondary.name: 'The Godfather of A.I.' Leaves Google and Warns of Danger Ahead, The New York Times (May 1, 2023)
Nobel Prize in Physics 2024, official citation

timeline.event: Moves to Canada, later founding the Toronto ML group
timeline.impact: Builds the school that produces the field's leaders

timeline.event: Turing Award with Bengio and LeCun
Resigns from Google to discuss AI dangers
timeline.impact: Risk debate gains its most decorated insider
Neural networks enter the scientific pantheon

quick_facts: Co-authored the 1986 backpropagation paper that made training deep networks practical
AlexNet (2012), built with his students Krizhevsky and Sutskever, ignited the deep-learning era
Turing Award 2018 (with Bengio and LeCun); Nobel Prize in Physics 2024 (with Hopfield)
Left Google in 2023 to speak freely about AI risk

achievements.title: Learning representations by back-propagating errors (1986, with Rumelhart and Williams)
achievements.impact: Made multi-layer network training practical, the algorithm modern AI still runs on.

achievements.title: AlexNet (2012, with Krizhevsky and Sutskever)
achievements.impact: Halved the ImageNet error rate and started the deep-learning gold rush; the lab was acquired by Google in 2013.

achievements.title: Turing Award 2018 and Nobel Prize in Physics 2024
achievements.impact: Computing's and science's highest honors for the same body of neural-network work.

achievements.title: The 2023 resignation and risk advocacy
achievements.impact: His departure from Google moved existential AI risk from fringe worry to boardroom and parliament agenda item.
